evidence.curator_note: Equation 8.38, first branch: 'R3C(+)CR'3 --> R3C+ + .CR'3  or  R3C. + (+)CR'3'. The concrete restatement of 8.37 line 1 for a C-C sigma bond between two substituted carbons; the two branches differ only in which fragment keeps the charge. This record encodes the FIRST/FAVORED branch. ARC COUNT (convention D): the book draws 0 curved arrows/fishhooks (straight reaction arrow). The 2 encoded electron_moves are IMPLICIT sigma homolysis: move <1> one electron of the cleaving C2-C3 bond OUT of the system (external ionization hole), move <2> the other onto C2 (ethyl radical); C3 becomes the cation. INSTANTIATION (convention F): instantiated with the exact worked example given in the running text on this page - the sigma-bond dissociation of C2H5-CH(CH3)2+. (2-methylbutane / ISOPENTANE) cleaving the ethyl-isopropyl C2-C3 bond. Mapping ethyl = C1-C2 (maps 1,2), isopropyl = C3 with its two methyls (maps 3,4,5). This branch gives the FAVORED polarization the text names: 'C2H5.--(+)CH(CH3)2 should be favored as the bond stretches, and the product abundance of +CH(CH3)2 should be greater than that of C2H5+' -> ethyl radical + isopropyl cation (+CH(CH3)2 = C3H7+). Curator-computed detected ion m/z 43.0542 (C3H7+); the page states this ion is the MORE abundant of the pair and notes C3H7+ (from C2H5 loss) is twice as abundant as C4H9+ (from CH3 loss), but prints NO numeric m/z or intensity, so detected=false / status inferred and no relative_intensity is recorded (convention F). LOCALIZATION (convention B): neutral isopentane skeleton with charge/radical in the fields + external-hole move (the loose 2c-1e sigma bond has no valence-correct single-atom SMILES), same convention as IMS4-EQ4.3.

NO MOD rule is indexed for Equation 8.38 (rule_index.json 'by_equation' stops at 8.14; no 8.38 key). No cross-link is asserted. The chapter-4 sigma dissociation rules IMS_4_3_var1/var2 encode the same class (OE+. C-C homolysis to EE+ carbenium + neutral radical) but are keyed to 4.3 (propane). m/z 43.0542 (C3H7+, isopropyl cation) is curator-computed from the isopentane instantiation named in the page text.
